outcome: left ventricular internal dimension in diastole (LVIDd)
cohort: 62 extremely low birth weight (ELBW) infants were analyzed during their first week of life.
finding: ELBW infants experienced hemodynamic instability characterized by decreased LVEF and increased ESWS during the first two days of life, with specific alterations in adaptation observed in SGA, hCAM, and severe IVH groups.
